🎥🍿: Children of Blood and Bone (2027)

In the kingdom of Orïsha, magic has been erased after a ruthless king wages war against the people who once possessed extraordinary powers. When a young woman named Zélie discovers she may hold the key to restoring magic, she sets out on a dangerous journey alongside her brother and an unlikely ally. Together, they must outrun powerful enemies determined to keep magic buried forever.

As their quest unfolds, the group faces impossible trials, ancient secrets, and growing political unrest that threatens to tear the kingdom apart. Every victory comes at a cost, forcing them to decide whether hope and unity can overcome fear and oppression.

The battle for Orïsha’s future builds toward an epic confrontation where courage, sacrifice, and destiny collide. With the fate of an entire kingdom hanging in the balance, Zélie must embrace her power before it is lost forever.

source_details.synopsis: Children of Blood and Bone is an upcoming American fantasy film directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, who co-wrote the screenplay with Tomi Adeyemi, based on the 2018 novel by Adeyemi. The film stars Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Regina King, Idris Elba, and Viola Davis. Children of Blood and Bone is scheduled to be released by Paramount Pictures in the United States on January 15, 2027.
